title: Purple Glowing Ores
description: This texture pack changes all the standard Minecraft ores by adding a bright purple outline to them. Whether you are deep in a cave or mining in the dark, you will never miss a diamond again!
body:
# Purple Glowing Ores

Purple Glowing Ores is a Minecraft resource pack that enhances ore visibility by adding bright purple glowing outlines to every ore block while keeping the original vanilla textures intact.

Designed for mining, exploration and survival gameplay, this pack makes valuable ores easier to spot in caves, ravines and the Nether without changing the core Minecraft experience. The glowing purple borders provide better visibility while maintaining a clean and vanilla-friendly look.

## Features
- Bright purple glowing ore outlines
- Improved ore visibility
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Clean and minimal style
- Perfect for mining and exploration
- No unnecessary visual clutter

![ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a851301af2268fd1d46ca53283020a569d94eae.png)

## Included Ores
- Coal Ore
- Iron Ore
- Copper Ore
- Gold Ore
- Redstone Ore
- Lapis Ore
- Emerald Ore
- Diamond Ore
- Nether Gold Ore
- Nether Quartz Ore
- Ancient Debris
- Deepslate variants

## Installation
- Download the pack
- Move the ZIP file into your resourcepacks folder
- Enable the pack in Minecraft
- Start exploring and mining

## Notes
This pack only modifies ore textures by adding purple glowing outlines. It does not affect gameplay and is designed to improve visibility while preserving the vanilla Minecraft aesthetic.
